state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** Eight of `nvs-runtime`'s ten goal-owned gaps are closed. The two newest:

- `the-peak-update-cost-is-argued-and-never-measured`: `the_memory_mark_stays_small_beside_the_allocation_it_fronts` in `benches/abi-probe/tests/perf_guards.rs` times the real `budget::carry` pair against a platform heap round trip, and `budget.rs` § *What it spends* cites it.
- `a-core-call-with-a-large-string-costs-time-per-byte`: the cost was `NvsStr::text_of`'s debug `from_utf8` over the whole payload. It now validates whole up to `VALIDATED_WHOLE` and at head and tail past it (`reads_as_text` in `crates/nvs-runtime/src/string.rs`).

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest, in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-runtime` (two), `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.
